title: tk client: locate the manifest from the embedded bundle, not the repository root
description:
Found by the Phase 1 gate run (cc5): a built ticfac binary run outside the ticfac checkout fails with "the tracker is not usable: locate tk JSON manifest: no go.mod above /: cannot locate the repository root". internal/tk locates contracts/tk-json-manifest.json through internal/contracts.RepoRoot() (a go.mod walk from cwd). A shipped binary has no checkout beside it. Read the manifest from the embedded bundle (root embedded.go already embeds contracts/ for version --json and the reconciler role-result validator uses the embedded job-protocol.json) and drop the RepoRoot dependency from the runtime path; keep RepoRoot for tests only. Scope: internal/tk (and embedded.go if a new export is needed). Do not touch internal/reconcile, internal/exec or other packages. Regression test: a test that builds the ticfac binary and runs "ticfac run-epic --repo <fixture> x" from a temp cwd outside the repo must get past manifest loading (it may then fail closed for another reason, but never with "cannot locate the repository root").

## How this fits
Wave 5 of epic qeu, running in parallel with the gate run cc5 (a report-only tick that touches no source). Integration commit cafe14885e3e22485cf757fa49fe261a52f103d8 on epic/qeu. Stdlib only; no go.mod/README/contracts edits. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor cafe14885e3e22485cf757fa49fe261a52f103d8 HEAD.
acceptance_criteria: ticfac binary run with cwd outside the repository loads the manifest; go test -short ./internal/tk/... ./internal/cli/... green; go test -short ./... green
